text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Daiwa Scarlet was,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, you worry too much.
If you insist that much, I'll go take a rest, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, what is this place?!Trainer... aren't you here?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Eep...!?
Could that over there be... a zombie!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Noooo! I told you horror is the one thing I can't handle!
Don't come over hereee!!

A confused Daiwa Scarlet's roundhouse kick
scored a clean hit on the zombie!
In that instant, a dazzling light filled the surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That was a pretty weak zombie.
Guess that proves I'm the strongest after all!

Her energy restored, Daiwa Scarlet
left the infirmary with a light step.

Reacting to Daiwa Scarlet's scream,
a zombie lunged toward us!
In that instant, a dazzling light filled the surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...A-A dream? This is seriously the worst...
There's no way I'm sleeping tonight...
Unable to get the dream out of her head, Daiwa Scarlet was unable to get enough rest.
